svg.aria-label: Step 20: The perfboard seen from the component side, column A on the left, with the 19 earlier steps drawn in grey. Hole A4 (printed J4 on the underside) is marked with a dot in a ring where W11, black, comes up from below; a dashed line shows it running behind the board to the left edge, on to the button (lead B). Below, a side view shows the board edge-on over the mount: the wire runs along the gap behind the board, up through the hole, and is soldered on the component side with its stub trimmed.
